message: Command `find /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul -type f | head -50; echo "==="; grep -rn "identify" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libexif --include=*.c --include=*.h | head -50` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: This is libexif. The vulnerability is about the `identify` function not checking if there's enough data before proceeding. Let me look at the work-vul directory and find the identify function.
